escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution
escalations.description: Unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary files and execute code when Vitest UI server is listening. No auth or origin validation.
escalations.exploit_scenario: CI/CD pipeline with vitest --ui running on a shared network. Any attacker on that network sends a crafted request to port 51204 to read /etc/passwd or inject code.

escalations.title: Handlebars.js Critical Template Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.description: Template engine allows JavaScript injection via AST type confusion. Attacker can execute arbitrary code within template context.
escalations.exploit_scenario: If any build artifact or config reads from user-supplied or attacker-modified templates at build time, RCE is triggered during the build pipeline.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search endpoint never registered in app.ts — 5 confirmed test failures
p1_findings.description: GET /api/search is tested (5 tests in search.test.ts) but the route is never registered in app.ts. DependencyPicker component silently gets no results at runtime.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: User opens dependency picker — zero results returned silently. Feature is non-functional in production.
p1_findings.impact: Feature regression: dependency search UI broken in production.
p1_findings.recommendation: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and add app.use('/api/search', searchRouter) to app.ts.

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from metrics.ts
p2_findings.description: 3 of 4 FR-dependency-metrics instruments present. The dependencyCheckDuration Histogram is missing — GET /metrics will never expose readiness check latency.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Histogram export to metrics.ts; record it in dependency.ts around isReady().

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and platform/ directories
p2_findings.description: Enforcer only scans Source/ and E2E/. Portal and platform FRs are invisible. Also: all requirements.md files share identical mtime causing non-deterministic CI target auto-detection.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend source_dirs to include portal and platform (guarded); pin CLAUDE.md gate to --file Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md.
p2_findings.cross_ref: [CROSS-REF: QO-004] same root cause — traceability tooling gaps

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-008 has zero Verifies: comments in platform/
p2_findings.description: FR-TMP-008 (gh CLI + Playwright in Dockerfile.worker) has zero // Verifies: comments anywhere in platform/ — only gap in an otherwise well-traced tiered-merge-pipeline.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 comment to platform/orchestrator/Dockerfile.worker.
p2_findings.cross_ref: [CROSS-REF: QO-003] same root cause — traceability tooling gaps

p2_findings.title: Brace-Expansion DoS (4 CVEs) — build tool pipeline at risk
p2_findings.description: Multiple DoS vectors: zero-step sequences, exponential expansion, unbounded arrays. Affects test runners and bundlers via glob patterns.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update brace-expansion (should pull >=1.1.18) in both Backend and Frontend.

p2_findings.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection via Unescaped Field Names
p2_findings.description: Multipart form-data doesn't escape field names/filenames. CRLF sequences can manipulate HTTP headers.

p2_findings.title: JS-YAML Quadratic Complexity DoS via Merge Key Chains
p2_findings.description: YAML with deeply nested merge keys forces O(n²) parsing causing CPU exhaustion and build pipeline hangs.
p2_findings.recommendation: npm install js-yaml@>=3.15.0; validate YAML input size; never parse untrusted YAML.

p2_findings.title: Esbuild Dev Server Origin Validation Bypass
p2_findings.description: Dev server doesn't validate request origin. External sites can read responses, leaking source maps and environment data.

p3_findings.title: Custom logger ignores LOG_LEVEL — always emits JSON
Enforcer FR regex produces 7 false-positive failures on entity IDs
spec-drift-report.json claims 0% coverage — stale artifact from misconfigured run
Express → QS DoS on malformed input
React Router DOM 1+ major version behind (6.26.0 vs 7.18.2)
Large transitive dependency tree (1,450+ packages) — high supply chain attack surface
No npm package signature verification — compromised packages undetected

p4_findings.title: eslint-disable comments in useWorkItems.ts and DependencyPicker.tsx lack rationale
Babel 2+ major versions behind (transitive, low-severity local file read CVE)

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Trigger TheGuardians full security audit; run npm audit fix --force; upgrade vitest@^4.1.10
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves both P1 escalations in one security sprint

cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Closes both P2 traceability findings in one tooling PR
